comment: One switch for diagnostics across the whole stack.
Debugging this mod means debugging three at once, and each keeps its settings
somewhere different: AAF takes them at runtime through its API, anything with
an MCM page takes them by name, and the engine's Papyrus logging is an ini the
game reads once at startup. A profile here drives all three.
Everything Rapport changes is named in Rapport.log, because the point of this
is not switching diagnostics on - it is switching them reliably back off.
The papyrus flags take effect on the NEXT launch, not this one, and Rapport
says so when it writes them. Fallout4Custom.ini is backed up once, the first
time, to Fallout4Custom.ini.before-rapport-debug.
DEVELOPMENT default is "debug". SHIPPING default is "off".
Papyrus tracing slows the script engine, which is the exact cost this mod
exists not to add - so it must be off in a release. On a development machine
that reasoning does not apply, and applying it anyway cost five debugging runs
spent chasing a dying Papyrus stack with the Papyrus log switched off.
It is cheap to leave on: troubleshooting_level stays 0 in both profiles, so
there are no modal pop-ups. The pop-ups that interrupted the owner once came
from that setting, never from logging.
Rapport says loudly at startup when this profile is active, so it cannot ship
this way without somebody having read the warning.
